name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Discs
desc: No-bake frozen discs of peanut butter, banana and Greek yogurt dipped in dark chocolate.

source.title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Discs
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1/2 cup plain whole milk Greek yogurt

steps: Line a baking sheet that fits in your freezer with parchment.
In a medium bowl, mix the banana, peanut butter, honey, peanuts and yogurt until fully combined.
Spoon the mixture onto the parchment in 10-12 portions and flatten each into a disc.
Freeze about 1 hr, until the discs are fully hard.
Melt the chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second bursts, stirring between each, until smooth.
Coat each frozen disc completely in chocolate (a fork works well), let the excess drip off, and set it back on the parchment. Sprinkle with flaky salt.
Freeze a few minutes more, until the chocolate is hard. Store in a freezer-safe container in the freezer.

references.title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Discs
references.usedFor: chopped peanuts, yield of 11 discs, freezer storage
